notes: §1985:XIII.3.22.4 GR1: a numeric item takes a numeric literal (a); an alphabetic, alphanumeric, alphanumeric edited or numeric edited item takes a nonnumeric literal, 'aligned in the data item as if the data item had been described as alphanumeric', editing having no effect (b); and 'Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED clause' (c). A report entry's literal reaches DataBinder.ScreenValueLiteral/ValidateValueCategory (COBOL1657 for the class mismatches), ScreenNumericEditedNumericLiteral refuses a numeric literal on a numeric edited item below 2023 (construct value-numeric-literal-numeric-edited-2023, COBOL0900), and ValueInitializer.InitializerFrom (called by ReportWriterEmitter.FieldImage) seeds the item as an initialization, not a MOVE. Probes (work-rr-04/v7*.cob): b) PIC ZZ9.99 VALUE 12.5 COBOL0900; X(5) VALUE 123, A(3) VALUE 1, XXBXX VALUE 12 COBOL1657; 9(3) VALUE SPACES and 99 VALUE ALL "1" COBOL1657; witness 9(3) VALUE "ABC" COBOL1657; d) one line 'ZZ9.99 " 12.50" | X(5) "AB" | X(5) JUSTIFIED RIGHT "AB" | 9(3) ZERO | ZZ9 ZERO | X(4) ALL "AB" | XXBXX "12 34" | A(3) "ABC" | 9V9 1.5' prints ' 12.50 AB    AB    000 000 ABAB 12 34 ABC 15' (JUSTIFIED ignored, edited images as written), $$9.99 "$1.00" and ZZ9 "ABC" print as written; c) BLANK WHEN ZERO with VALUE is refused by the 1985 Table 1 screen (COBOL2247, kb/Work PB5243), so GR1c's BWZ arm is not reachable at 85. Classes a, e, f have no arm in a report VALUE.

next.reason: 1985 b requires a nonnumeric literal for a numeric edited report item ('literal-1 in the VALUE clause must be a nonnumeric literal'; editing has no effect). 2023 accepts a numeric one: §2023:13.18.63.3 SR6 'literals in formats 1, 2, and 4 of the VALUE clause may be numeric', edited per §2023:13.18.63.3 SR11 (applied to format 4 by §2023:13.18.63.3 SR34), and BLANK WHEN ZERO then affects initialization (only alphanumeric/national literals are exempt, §2023:13.18.63.4 GR8, §2023:13.18.63.3 SR8). Looser. Numeric-category (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR2), alphanumeric-category (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR4), alignment and 'not affected by a JUSTIFIED clause and no editing' for nonnumeric literals (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR7, via §2023:13.18.63.4 GR21) are kept, so every 1985 VALUE means the same; the BWZ difference arises only in the new numeric-literal case.
